content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for ICAR IARI Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for ICAR IARI?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Young Professional-I and Semi-skilled Worker posts at ICAR IARI is scheduled for 01 September 2026. Candidates are advised to be present at the venue on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What are the eligibility criteria for the Young Professional-I post?
faq.answer: For the Young Professional-I position, candidates must possess a B.Tech. degree in Agricultural Engineering. This is the primary educational qualification required for this role.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification for the Semi-skilled Worker position?
faq.answer: The minimum educational qualification for the Semi-skilled Worker post at ICAR IARI is a 10th pass. Candidates who have completed their 10th standard are eligible to apply.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the ICAR IARI recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit for all the posts is between 18 years and 45 years. There are also provisions for age relaxation for certain categories as per government norms.

faq.question: Q5. Are there any application fees for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, as per the provided information, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive by ICAR IARI.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Young Professional-I post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Young Professional-I post will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 30,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for the Semi-skilled Worker position?
faq.answer: The Semi-skilled Worker will be offered a consolidated salary of Rs. 15,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Young Professional-I and Semi-skilled Worker posts at ICAR IARI will be based on a Virtual Interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the walk-in interview going to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at the ICAR-Indian Agricultural Research Institute, New Delhi, 110012.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies, including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if any), and category certificates (if applicable).
